title: Audit Support Needed to Identify Timing Contrasts under Latent Reporting in Four-Wave Panels
banked_reason: The promised necessary-and-sufficient validation-window and report-support criterion is still explicitly open; achieved tier incremental below field floor.
gap_reasons: The promised necessary-and-sufficient validation-window/report-support criterion with positive twins below the frontier is still explicitly open: the core supplies only a separated/full-rank eight-cell sufficient certificate, a zero-audit alias, and a decidable reduction; complete the uniform rule and failing-support witnesses, or formally redirect the central promise to this partial result.
proof_attempt_summary: The run reduced the timing-contrast problem to degree-nine mixing moments, established an eight-cell sufficient certificate under separation and rank conditions, and gave a positive no-audit alias. A D0 maximality pass attempted the nonlinear cross-nuisance singleton-mask systems but obtained only a finite semialgebraic reduction, not positive audited twins or a complete support criterion. D0.5 passed the math and cited-source checks but rated the delivered package incremental, below the field floor.
tldr: The fixed four-wave design has an eight-cell cube that generically identifies the timing contrast on the separated full-rank nuisance stratum and an exact positive no-audit alias. A finite polynomial reduction bounds every cross-nuisance search by ten atoms per type and schedule in each model and makes every fixed-support question decidable in principle. The evaluated uniform singleton decision and complete support frontier remain open.
gap: Existing observed-choice spans, HMM identification theorems, verification-bias corrections, and conditional mixture calibration do not classify phase-I report supports for this selective-gold causal target with cross-coefficient and cross-channel aliases.
fill: Establish a necessary-and-sufficient support rule for the fixed four-wave window. The eight-cell cube family is a concrete upper certificate, and the schedule-uniform positive alias is an exact report-only lower principle; failing masks require feasible positive complete-law twins or an explicit exceptional-law qualification.
